faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for IIT Madras Patent Agent Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date for submission of the online application for IIT Madras Patent Agent Recruitment 2026 is 26 August 2026. Candidates are advised to apply well before the deadline.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in IIT Madras Patent Agent Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy for the Patent Agent post in the IIT Madras Recruitment 2026 drive. This offers a specific opportunity for eligible candidates.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for IIT Madras Patent Agent posts?
faq.answer: The application mode for the Patent Agent posts at IIT Madras is online. Interested and eligible candidates must submit their applications through the official website.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary for the Patent Agent post at IIT Madras?
faq.answer: The salary for the Patent Agent post at IIT Madras is Rs. 25000 Per Month. This compensation is offered to the selected candidates for the contract position.

faq.question: Q5. What are the educational qualifications required for the Patent Agent position?
faq.answer: Candidates must be a Registered Indian Patent Agent, hold a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Chemical Engineering (preferred), and have 0-5 years of experience in IP-related work.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for IIT Madras Patent Agent Recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for the IIT Madras Patent Agent Recruitment 2026. The fee is Nil for all.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for IIT Madras Patent Agent Recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process includes Online Application, Shortlisting of candidates, a Test/Interview, and Document Verification. Candidates must clear all stages to be selected.

faq.question: Q8. Where can I find the official notification for IIT Madras Patent Agent Recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF for IIT Madras Patent Agent Recruitment 2026 can be downloaded from the Important Links section provided in this article. It contains all detailed information.

faq.question: Q9. What is the official website for IIT Madras recruitment?
faq.answer: The official website for IIT Madras recruitment and related information is https://icandsr.iitm.ac.in. Candidates can visit this site for application and updates.

faq.question: Q10. What is the job location for the Patent Agent post?
faq.answer: The job location for the Patent Agent post at IIT Madras is Chennai, Tamil Nadu. Selected candidates will be required to work at the institute's campus in Chennai.
